subject: Philz Coffee for Genentech South San Francisco meetings and office service
body:
Hello Genentech Supplier Relations team,

Philz Coffee’s wholesale program supports offices and special occasions, and I’m reaching out regarding Genentech’s South San Francisco campus. Your campus spans more than 40 buildings and includes cafeteria locations and other workforce amenities, so I wanted to ask who manages coffee sourcing for Workplace Services, Facilities, or Food Services.

We could explore a Philz program for hosted meetings, employee gatherings, or approved office service using Philz’s handcrafted coffee and customized blends. We would tailor the conversation to Genentech’s supplier requirements and would not propose a resale arrangement.

Would you please route this to the appropriate campus hospitality or procurement contact? I’d be glad to send a concise program overview and sample options.

Best,
Philz Coffee Wholesale
wholesale@philzcoffee.com

subject: A Philz Coffee option for Stanford Catering’s coffee services
body:
Hello Stanford Catering team,

I saw that Stanford Catering supports everything from intimate board meetings and high-touch coffee services to large academic conferences. Philz Coffee’s wholesale program may be a useful option for selected hosted events or special occasions where a handcrafted, customized coffee experience would complement the menu.

Philz is also an experience-led brand with a focus on customized coffee and sustainable sourcing. We would be happy to discuss packaged coffee or approved event-service formats that fit Stanford’s policies, budget, and existing catering model—not coffee brewed for resale.

Would the catering team be open to a brief introduction, or could you point me to the person responsible for coffee sourcing and approved vendors?

Best,
Philz Coffee Wholesale
wholesale@philzcoffee.com

subject: Philz Coffee for UCSF meetings and special events
body:
Hello UCSF Conference and Event Services,

I’m reaching out because UCSF supports conferences and events across its San Francisco locations, with catering options coordinated through Campus Life Services. Philz Coffee’s wholesale program serves offices and special occasions, and we’d like to explore whether Philz could support selected UCSF meetings, receptions, or hosted events.

We understand UCSF has an existing primary catering partner and that outside catering may require approval. Our goal would be to understand the approved-vendor process and identify an appropriate, non-resale format—such as packaged coffee or Philz service for qualifying events.

Could you point me to the person who manages coffee vendors or catering approvals? I can send a short overview with service formats and ordering information.

Best,
Philz Coffee Wholesale
wholesale@philzcoffee.com
